summary: In this interview-style overview from Backyard Barn Finds, Joe of JWC Performance walks through practical LS-swap considerations for a classic car. The discussion centers on budget-driven choices (e.g., Dart blocks as a cost-effective option), fitment challenges (engine mounts, crossmember, exhaust clearance), cooling and capacity (radiator and twin fans; Vintage Air front-runner kit vs factory setups), and modern electrical/wiring approaches (updated harnesses, SpearTech PCM integration). The video also covers fuel delivery strategies (in-tank pump and new tank), and EFI versus carbureted planning, with hands-on notes about billet valve covers and coil-pack mounting. The overall message emphasizes balancing cost, reliability, and drivability when converting a classic car to modern LS power with modern electronics.
